Campaign Build Structure

Google Search & Meta Ads

1. Google Search Campaign Complete Structure

1.1 Account Settings

  • Network: Search Network only. No Display Network, no Search Partners at this budget.
  • Bidding: Start on Maximize Clicks with a manual CPC ceiling while conversions accumulate. Move to Maximize Conversions once 15 to 20 tracked conversions have landed.
  • Locations: Naperville, IL plus Aurora, Lisle, Warrenville, Wheaton, Downers Grove, Bolingbrook, Plainfield, Woodridge, Oswego, St. Charles.
  • Languages: English.
  • Devices: All devices, with an upward bid adjustment on mobile given local near me search intent.
  • Ad Schedule: Business hours plus early evening, to be refined once call conversion data comes in.
